correctness.rationale: A radius-one geometric graph Čech face is exactly a subset of some closed vertex neighborhood; pairwise neighborhood intersections have line size q at Hamming distance one and size two at distance two. This proves unique non-line faces of size >=3, hence the first descending-cardinality matching is an elementary collapse; surviving line faces admit the second descending-cardinality matching. The complete remaining 2-skeleton has exactly the stated corner and fan triangles and all distance <=2 edges. It is simply connected because any distance-two edge is reduced by a corner triangle and coordinate triangles/squares fill the 2-skeleton of the contractible product of simplices. Integral homology, Euler characteristic and Hurewicz/Whitehead yield the wedge formula. Exact finite certificate replays all specified free-face removals and independent mod-two ranks on seven finite parameter choices, including two new parameter choices, and is supplementary rather than the universal proof.

value.rationale: A natural two-parameter family of graph-metric Čech nerves has maximal simplex dimension \(n(q-1)\) tending to infinity in both parameters, yet every member has a constructive 2-dimensional simple-homotopy model. The exact free integral H2 rank formula is new beyond the previously known binary all-dimensions, multinary two-dimensional, and isolated \((3,3)\) domains; cases \(B\((3,4)\)=783\) and \(B\((4,3)\)=836\) show nontrivial new numerical invariants. The result is motivated by a concrete gap between those published partial families, not by arbitrary choice of one finite graph.
